name: W Dubai - The Palm

address.street: West Crescent Palm Jumeirah - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This ultra-modern resort on Palm Jumeirah's crescent puts you literally on a man-made island that's visible from space - talk about an exclusive address.
whats_special: W Dubai - The Palm sits on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, one of the world's largest artificial islands shaped like a palm tree. The hotel features the region's first AWAY Spa and boasts unobstructed views of Dubai's glittering skyline across the Arabian Gulf. Its signature rooftop pool becomes a vibrant party scene after dark, while the property's location offers direct beach access to pristine white sand.
pro_tip: Book a Palm Sea View room on higher floors for Instagram-worthy shots of the Dubai Marina skyline, especially during golden hour when the city lights begin to twinkle.
dont_miss: The hotel's FIRE restaurant serves up Lebanese cuisine with panoramic marina views, while the rooftop WET Deck transforms from a chic day club to Dubai's hottest nightlife destination. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to Nakheel Mall and don't skip the signature W cocktails at the WET Bar as the sun sets over the Palm.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on iconic Palm Jumeirah
Vibrant W Hotels signature design and atmosphere
Multiple world-class dining venues and rooftop bars
Direct beach access with premium water sports facilities
cons: Contemporary party atmosphere may not suit all travelers
